name: Past Kouga
source:
Kouga's previous incarnation, who made a contract with Futaba's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]Past Futaba ended up dying in his arms, and past Kouga considered her death to be his failure. This guilt carried over into his next life as Kouga.[/spoiler]
